dogecoin.text:
In 2017, ideas like this were wild. Meme coins didn’t exist, and even Dogecoin wasn’t taken seriously.

But sunnybear did not give a shit. He believed his “get paid for farting” concept would someday revolutionize the crypto space.

And honestly? He was fucking right. https://t.co/amOSAsLsrc

In 2017, crypto was a different world:
-Bitcoin was hovering around $1,000
-Dogecoin was still just a joke
-Meme coins? Completely unheard of

sunnybear was ahead of his time

He had a dream: monetize farts and get paid in Bitcoin

No memes, just farts 💨
